text: This sentence is on a product page. In the European Union, it is now banned, unless the seller can prove the claim.
Claim Check marks the claims that are now illegal, on the page you are shopping on.
Directive 2024 slash 825 applies from the twenty-seventh of September, 2026. It covers stock already on the shelves.
Eco-friendly. Climate neutral. Biodegradable. Without proof of recognised excellent performance, the words themselves are the problem.
Claim Check reads the visible text of the page and lists what matches. Four banned claims here, and two that need evidence.
Each finding quotes the sentence, marks the exact phrase, and names the article, plus the evidence that would make it lawful.
Six rules. Four banned practices, and two that need evidence.
And it stays quiet when the words are ordinary. Green tea is not a green claim.
One bookmark, any product page. No account, no extension.
The page text never leaves the browser. That is what makes it safe on a checkout page.
Thirteen saved pages. Three findings, all reviewed as true positives. A pilot, not a survey.
It cannot see images, it does not judge the product, and it reads English only.
The directive already names the words. Claim Check shows you where they are.
